title: Pre-Existing Conditions, Tenant Damage and Replacement Settlement Figures — Rental Tiers
content:
Coverage switches and settlement figures of Rental Property Service Contracts, by tier.

| Tier | Unknown, undetectable pre-existing failures covered | Failures caused by tenant misuse or damage covered | Repair-to-replace threshold | Cash-in-lieu offer open for | Cash in lieu paid within |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | no | no | 0.60 | 30 days | 10 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | no | no | 0.60 | 30 days | 10 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | no | no | 0.60 | 30 days | 10 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | no | no | 0.60 | 30 days | 10 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | no | no | 0.60 | 30 days | 10 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | no | no | 0.60 | 30 days | 10 days |

## Column meanings

- The repair-to-replace threshold is the repair estimate, as a fraction of the contracted replacement cost, at or above which Bridgewell replaces.
- The cash-in-lieu offer period is the number of calendar days after a cash-in-lieu offer within which it may be accepted; the payment period is the number of calendar days after acceptance within which cash in lieu is paid.

## Hypothetical threshold readings

With a contracted replacement cost of $1000.00, the threshold of 0.60 sits at $600.00: a repair estimate of $600.00 is at the threshold, and one of $599.99 is below it.
